content: Musey Isra7eele asaa kaaleththiza korapinnetas, «GODAY azazida azazoy hayssafe kaallizayssa,
Issi asi GODAAS issi miish ooththanaas adinettiko woykko issaadey caaqqi geppidi bana barkka ba qaalan qachchiko izi ba gelida qaala ubbaa polana bessees attiin ba gidayssa agganaas bessenna.
«Issi geela7oya ba aawa soon dashe GODAAS issi miish ooththanaas adinettiko woykko caaqqa geppada bana barkka ba qaalan qachchizaa gidikko,
izi aaway hessa siyidi izo diggontta aggiko iza ba adinettidayssa woykko ba caaqqa geppida qaalaza polanaas bessees.
Izi aaway he yo7oza siyidi izo diggizaa gidikko iza adinettida adinay woykko iza caaqqa geppida qaalay izis gome gidenna; gaasoykka izi aaway izo diggida gishshas GODAY izo maarana.
«Azina gelontta maccassi akeekada woykko akeekontta adina adinetta uttada woykko caaqqa geppada bana barkka ba qaalan qachcha woththada azina gelikko,
iza gelida azinazi he yo7oza siyidi izo diggontta aggiko iza ba gidayssa ubbaa polanaas bessees.
Izi azinay he yo7oza siyidi izo diggizaa gidikko iza adinettida adinay woykko iza caaqqa geppida qaalay izis gome gidenna; gaasoykka izi azinay izo diggida gishshas GODAY izo maarana.
«Azinay hayqqida maccassi woykko azinay anjji yeddida maccassi issi miish ooththanaas adinettiko woykko caaqqa geppada bana barkka ba qaalan qachchidaa gidikko iza ba gelida qaalaa polanaas bessees.
«Azina gelida maccassi issi miish ooththanaas adinettiko woykko caaqqa geppada bana barkka ba qaalan qachchidaa gidikko,
iza gelida azinazi he yo7oza siyidi izo diggontta aggiko iza ba gidayssa ubbaa polanaas bessees.
Izi azinay he yo7oza siyidi izo diggizaa gidikko iza adinettida adinay woykko iza caaqqa geppida qaalay izis gome gidenna; gaasoykka izi azinay izo diggida gishshas GODAY izo maarana.
Izi azinay ay adina woykko caaqqa geppada bana barkka qachchida qaalaa digganaas woykko polisanaas izas maatay dees.

Izi azinay he yo7oza siyida mala wonteththa gallas aykkoka qaattontta co7u giikko iza ba gidayssa ubbaa polanaas bessees; he yo7oza siyida mala aykkoka qaattontta co7u giikko hessi izi ero gidayssa qonccisees.
Gido attiin izi azinay gam7idi he izi adinaza diggizaa gidikko alaafeteththan oyshettanay iza» gides.

Geela7oynne gelida maccassi adina adinettiko woykko caaqqa geppada barkka bana ba qaalan qachchidaa gidikko izi aawaas woykko izi azinaas diza alaafeteththanne maataa gishshas GODAY Muses immida wogay hayssa.
